reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but independently implements daily occurrence filtering in three consumers.

duplication.why: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange repeat the daily weekend-and-holiday exclusion policy added to getNextDate.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts and handler registration belongs in schedules/app.ts, but recurrence adjustment policy remains spread across server consumers.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling rules, range handler, associated types, tests, and release note.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must synchronize several implementations of the same scheduling policy, including separate occurrence-search limits and caller-side frequency dispatch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement daily exclusion rather than sharing the policy introduced in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily exclusion decision appears as a find predicate in getNextDate, a filter in getUpcomingDates, and nested conditions with continue statements in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter, getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch, and getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange independently implement that daily policy.
